all.note: truncated means the instruments interval claims data the feature series does not contain. It is a flag, not a verdict: a delisting or merger can legitimately end trading before the index removes the name, while a still-listed symbol ending early is a real gap (compare with delist dates). This does not replace the stale-vs-delisted check.
